title: Strategy selection research cycle
disclaimer: Public research demo — not regulated financial advice. Historical backtests on liquid equities; past performance is not future returns. No live brokerage account data is shown.
question: How do candidate strategy families compare on one sample for a long-only liquid equity sleeve, and what holdings changes does the working (or human-selected) policy imply?
constraints: Human approval before any live trades
Prefer lower turnover when risk-adjusted returns are close
Proposals follow working / human-selected strategy (not auto-switched)
Flag adopt-for-future only if an eligible lead clears a Sharpe change bar

decision.run_reason: Proposals use working policy (Momentum · semiannual · max 3 name changes), which also leads (or ties) the eligible set under selection rules.

rows.label: Broad ETF buy&hold (VWCE)
rows.research_note: Passive global equity baseline (opportunity cost vs stock book).

rows.label: Universe equal-weight buy&hold
rows.research_note: Do-nothing concentrated alternative: hold the liquid universe EW.

rows.label: Momentum · semiannual · max 3 name changes
rows.research_note: Working policy: cost-aware 12m momentum with capped name turnover.

rows.label: Low volatility · semiannual · top 10
rows.research_note: Low-risk anomaly (e.g. Ang–Hodrick–Xing–Zhang): hold the quietest names by trailing realized vol.

rows.label: Short-term reversal · semiannual · top 10
rows.research_note: Short-term reversal (Jegadeesh / Lehmann): buy recent 1m losers (contrarian to last month's tape).

rows.label: Wildcard · latest 6m trend · top 10
rows.research_note: Wildcard each review: hold the strongest ~6-month price trends (tactical intermediate trend, refreshed every 6 months).
